music.title: Golden Storm
music.use_conditions: Allowed: social media video posts, online marketing ads, YouTube. Not allowed: inside video games, TV/radio broadcast, CDs/DVDs, music-only remixes, rights-management registration.
music.selection: 49 Mixkit electronic/EDM/pop candidates measured with audio.py beats; chosen for 127 BPM (0.8% from the film's 128 BPM grid), a +10.8 dB drop on beat 32 preceded by a 2.75-beat drop-out, and 33 beats of full energy after it
music.audition: measured only: this environment has no listening operation, so the choice rests on tempo, structure and loudness measurements plus the genre

sfx: the film's own effects (SHARD's game sounds and Pixabay-licensed library effects, see src/sfx/assets/sfx/CREDITS.md), rebuilt from the film's cue list
